title: Warranty Coverage Discount Program Clause for Labor Rates
content:
**Clause.** When the contract a Warranty Coverage registration covers was signed under the military discount program, the labor program discount is that contract series' military discount rate; under the first-responder program it is the series' first-responder discount rate; under the senior program it is the series' senior discount rate; with no discount program there is no labor program discount. The labor program discount reduces the plan's hourly labor rate.

## Where the program and the rates are read

| Registration covers | Read from |
|---|---|
| a window contract | the Window Replacement Contracts record of the contract (its discount program) and its series' program rates |
| a door contract | the Entry & Patio Door Contracts record of the contract and its series' program rates |

## Program and discount

| Program the contract was signed under | Labor program discount |
|---|---|
| military | the series' military discount rate |
| first-responder | the series' first-responder discount rate |
| senior | the series' senior discount rate |
| none | none |

## Case (hypothetical rates)

A window contract signed under the senior program in a series whose senior discount rate is a hypothetical 6 percent: a hypothetical plan hourly labor rate of 100.00 is reduced by 6 percent, to 94.00.
